title: .asf.yaml
description: Configuration file for Apache Software Foundation repositories. See: https://github.com/apache/infrastructure-asfyaml#working-with-asfyaml

meta.title: Parser settings
meta.description: Settings for the .asf.yaml parser itself. This section is not validated server-side.

environment.description: Additional environment to enable for this run. The 'production' environment is always enabled.

environments.description: Additional environments to enable for this run. The 'production' environment is always enabled.

cache.description: Whether the parser may skip features whose configuration is unchanged.

test.title: Test feature
test.description: Internal test fixture used by the asfyaml test suite. Not for production use.
